description: The file defines classes related to database record set iteration, specifically 'ADODB_Iterator' which implements PHP's Iterator interface for iterating over database results, and 'ADODB_BASE_RS' which provides an iterable base record set. It supports PHP5 iteration mechanisms for database query results within the ADODB library.

classes.name: ADODB_Iterator
classes.description: Implements PHP's Iterator interface to allow iteration over database result sets, providing methods for rewind, validation, key retrieval, current record retrieval, and moving to next record. It also forwards method calls to the underlying recordset object.

classes.name: ADODB_BASE_RS
classes.description: A base record set class implementing IteratorAggregate, providing an iterable wrapper around itself via ADODB_Iterator, and a string representation method that exports its data using an external export function.

methods.name: ADODB_Iterator::__construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the iterator with a database result set object.

methods.name: ADODB_Iterator::rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the result set to the first record.

methods.name: ADODB_Iterator::valid
methods.description: Checks whether the current position in the result set is valid (not EOF).

methods.name: ADODB_Iterator::current
methods.description: Returns the fields of the current record.

methods.name: ADODB_Iterator::next
methods.description: Advances to the next record in the result set.

methods.name: ADODB_Iterator::__call
methods.description: Forwards method calls to the underlying record set object, enabling dynamic method invocation.

methods.name: ADODB_Iterator::hasMore
methods.description: Checks if there are more records to read (equivalent to not EOF).

methods.name: ADODB_BASE_RS::getIterator
methods.description: Returns an ADODB_Iterator object initialized with this record set, enabling PHP's foreach iteration.

methods.name: ADODB_BASE_RS::__toString
methods.description: Exports the record set as a string by including an external export script and calling the _adodb_export function.
